# EditableFrames

> EditableFrames is an MIT-licensed beta JavaScript framework for code-generated video with optional scene-specific controls, stable anchors, validated edits and reversible history. Built by parent company Stitchable.

The independent browser playground has 12 curated studies using Canvas and Three.js. It saves PNG frames and runtime-specific JSON edit recipes, not video files. Browser edits stay on the device. The local SDK supports MP4 with audio, transparent ProRes 4444 MOV and PNG/WAV sequences for supported clip projects. The hosted studies are not all CLI export templates.

The framework is model-neutral and needs no Stitchable account or model API key. Its CLI and shared SKILL.md can be used by tool-capable agents; host-specific integration needs independent testing. The beta runs trusted local JavaScript, not arbitrary untrusted code. Control schemas do not restrict future renderers or creative source code.

## Authoritative pages
- [Playground and collection](https://editableframes.stitchable.ai/): 12 interactive code-generated scenes.
- [Browser guide](https://editableframes.stitchable.ai/guide/): Playback, controls, history and saved settings.
- [Framework reference](https://editableframes.stitchable.ai/reference/): Controls, agent setup, export scope and current limits.
- [Credits](https://editableframes.stitchable.ai/credits/): Framework, library, device and HDR licenses.
- [MIT source](https://github.com/Stitchable-ai/editable-frames): Setup and source code.
- [Beta contract](https://github.com/Stitchable-ai/editable-frames/blob/main/docs/beta.md): Implemented capabilities and gaps.
- [Agent setup](https://github.com/Stitchable-ai/editable-frames/blob/main/docs/agents.md): Shared skill and CLI usage.
- [Stitchable Pro Studio](https://stitchable.ai/studio/): Parent company's broader video-editing product.

## Examples
- [3D phone product demo](https://editableframes.stitchable.ai/genres/device/): iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 12 and Pixel 6 swaps, app screens and camera controls.
- [Scientific U-Net explainer](https://editableframes.stitchable.ai/genres/unet/): Teaching schematic; not neural inference.
- [Paper animation](https://editableframes.stitchable.ai/genres/paper/): Colors, texture and held-pose timing.
- [Isometric logistics](https://editableframes.stitchable.ai/genres/warehouse/): Parcel movement and camera framing.
